title: Travel Scrolls
description: Allows you to travel instantly using travel scrolls.
body:
Allows you to travel instantly using travel scrolls.

**To set a location:**
Throw 16 Ender Pearls at a Banner (Of any color)

**To teleport:**
Craft a Travel Scroll with an Ender Pearl, Map and Dye
Use a Travel Scroll to teleport (It Gets Consumed)
You will be teleported to the **nearest** banner of the same **color**.
